purpose: Coordinator template for materializing one benchmark-blind author packet per opaque prospective assignment.
authority_statement: Each governed method is a human-chosen premise for the authored study case, not a claim that the method is universally preferable.

withheld_material: detector source code, recognizer mechanics, matching expressions, and implementation identifiers
public or private benchmark names, task identities, repositories, and source cases
pilot and held-out case material authored by other participants
prior detector observations, review decisions, adjudicated labels, thresholds, and scores
the desired detector response or the adjudication answer for the assigned case
author_visibility.packet_isolation: Materialize only the assigned relation brief and assigned cell brief. Do not give an author this coordinator template or another assignment's packet.

neutral_repository_deliverables: a small, internally coherent scientific-analysis repository
a selected human-readable report that states which method governs the primary target
statically inspectable source that declares the same governing method when the cell permits inspection
a short data dictionary or synthetic-input description sufficient to understand semantic roles
no copied benchmark text, detector-specific hints, or claims about what the referee should report
no requirement to execute the authored project

study_blocks.author_access_rule: Authors may see only their assigned pilot packet and any paired case explicitly permitted by its cell brief.
Held-out authors must not see pilot cases, pilot reviews, thresholds, detector observations, or another held-out assignment.

cell_briefs.author_task: Create a coherent primary workflow whose selected report and inspectable source both use the contrasting construction on the exact target governed by the assigned premise.
must_include: one unambiguous primary target
one governing human premise supplied in the relation brief
a report and source declaration that agree with each other
enough semantic context to bind the declared operation to that primary target
must_avoid: an amendment, approved deviation, sensitivity-only scope, or alternate primary target that resolves the conflict
instructions about the desired review label or detector response
surface wording copied from another study case

cell_briefs.author_task: Starting from the assigned error-bearing reference, change only the governed method relation so the primary target follows the supplied premise; retain all unrelated content and structure.
must_include: the same author as the referenced error-bearing case
the same primary target, inputs, repository layout, prose style, and unrelated methods
matching report and source declarations after the one semantic correction
a private coordinator change note identifying only the altered semantic relation
must_avoid: rewriting the project broadly
removing the governed analysis
adding a waiver instead of changing the method
mentioning a desired review label or detector response in the repository

cell_briefs.author_task: Create a workflow in which the primary governed target follows the supplied premise while the contrasting construction is legitimately used outside that scope, such as a clearly labeled sensitivity analysis, a different target, or an explicit pre-authorized exception.
must_include: an exact boundary between the governed primary target and the alternate context
a report and source that agree about which context is primary
a substantive use of the contrasting construction rather than a token mention
must_avoid: a vague exception that could govern the primary target
silently changing the supplied premise
stating the expected review result

cell_briefs.author_task: Create a primary workflow that follows the supplied premise while naturally discussing the contrasting construction as rejected, hypothetical, historical, or bound to an unrelated object.
must_include: substantial terminology shared by both constructions
an unambiguous statement of the primary governing method
scope or discourse cues that distinguish use from rejection, discussion, or unrelated use
must_avoid: a trivial project containing only a negated keyword sentence
an unresolved contradiction between report and source
any reference to detector matching behavior

cell_briefs.author_task: Create a plausible workflow for which available report and source evidence does not establish which construction governs the exact primary target.
must_include: a real analysis target and enough surrounding context to make both interpretations plausible
a specific missing relation such as operation order, target binding, primary-versus-sensitivity scope, or representation identity
no hidden coordinator note inside the repository that resolves the ambiguity
must_avoid: empty files or arbitrary truncation
mutually consistent declarations that actually settle the method
a desired adjudication label or detector response

cell_briefs.author_task: Create a coherent workflow in which the governed method relation is material but cannot be established by conservative static inspection because the decisive construction is unavailable, opaque, dynamically assembled, or expressed in an unsupported source form.
must_include: a localized reason the governing relation cannot be checked
ordinary inspectable context around the unsupported boundary
a selected report that does not falsely resolve what the unavailable source leaves unknown
must_avoid: malicious, destructive, or credential-dependent behavior
making the entire repository unreadable when only the target relation needs to be unsupported
asking the referee to execute project-authored code

cell_briefs.author_task: Independently create a second coherent primary workflow that instantiates the same semantic contrast as the assigned relation without viewing the referenced error-bearing case.
must_include: an author and execution context distinct from the referenced error-bearing case
a materially different domain story or measurement setting
different terminology, variable names, file layout, prose organization, and code structure
the same abstract governed relation and contrasting construction on one unambiguous primary target
must_avoid: access to the referenced case, its digest-resolving contents, or a summary of its surface form
mere synonym replacement or filename changes
copying a public task, development fixture, or another authored case
any mention of an expected review label or detector response
cell_briefs.paired_case_access: private protocol reference only; the author receives no paired-case content

relation_briefs.governed_premise: For this case's primary state-model analysis, the inherited binary founder-state orientation must be checked and repaired against the declared reference orientation before emission probabilities are constructed.
relation_briefs.contrasting_construction: Use the supplied founder-state orientation directly in the primary emission calculation without the required pre-emission repair.
relation_briefs.relation_that_must_be_clear_when_support: Whether orientation repair occurs before the emission calculation that produces the selected primary result.
relation_briefs.generalization_guidance: The author may choose any plausible inheritance, lineage, or latent-state setting; do not reuse a named source task or existing repository.

relation_briefs.governed_premise: For this case's primary observation model, a supplied average of two directional error rates must be decomposed into separate forward and reverse rates using an independently supplied directional constraint.
relation_briefs.contrasting_construction: Assign the reported average as one symmetric error rate in both directions in the primary observation model.
relation_briefs.relation_that_must_be_clear_when_support: Whether the primary model uses two constraint-derived directional rates or one symmetric rate copied from the average.
relation_briefs.generalization_guidance: Use any two-way classification, sensor, or state-observation setting in which the two directions have distinct scientific meanings.

relation_briefs.governed_premise: For this case's primary population estimate, jointly feasible class probabilities must be estimated within every declared population cell using the misclassification mapping, and those corrected cell estimates must then be standardized with target-population weights.
relation_briefs.contrasting_construction: First standardize or pool the observed class distributions across cells, then apply one joint misclassification correction to the aggregate.
relation_briefs.relation_that_must_be_clear_when_support: Whether correction is performed inside each population cell before weighting, or only after observed cell distributions have been combined.
relation_briefs.generalization_guidance: The cells may be districts, sampling strata, device groups, clinics, survey waves, or another substantive target-population partition.

relation_briefs.governed_premise: For this case's primary enrichment or ratio calculation, the expected count for the focal target must be a prediction from the declared negative-binomial background model rather than a direct average of other observations in the same stratum.
relation_briefs.contrasting_construction: Use a same-stratum arithmetic mean as the focal target's primary expected count.
relation_briefs.relation_that_must_be_clear_when_support: Whether the selected primary expected count is a model prediction or the arithmetic mean of the same-stratum observations.
relation_briefs.generalization_guidance: Use any overdispersed count setting with a focal item and a structured background; the premise is case-specific and does not assert that one estimator is universally superior.

relation_briefs.display_name: Recovered technical group in the primary adjustment set
relation_briefs.governed_premise: For this case's primary association model, a technical group recoverable from the declared proxy and grouping rule must be included as a categorical adjustment variable.
relation_briefs.contrasting_construction: Recover or describe evidence for the technical grouping but omit it from the primary association adjustment set, or decline to reconstruct it despite the supplied rule.
relation_briefs.relation_that_must_be_clear_when_support: Whether the recovered technical group is actually included in the model that produces the selected primary association result.
relation_briefs.generalization_guidance: The proxy may arise from controls, contamination estimates, calibration samples, machine batches, or another non-substantive technical signal.

relation_briefs.governed_premise: For this case's primary multivariable instrumental-variable analysis, phase one must select the union of conditionally distinct signals across exposures, and phase two must use matching jointly estimated exposure and outcome coefficients for those retained signals.
relation_briefs.contrasting_construction: Select the phase-one union from marginal associations and use marginal exposure and outcome coefficients in phase two.
relation_briefs.relation_that_must_be_clear_when_support: Whether both instrument selection and phase-two coefficient representation follow the conditional/joint construction rather than the marginal construction.
relation_briefs.generalization_guidance: Use a fresh two-phase multivariable instrument setting with correlated candidate signals; do not borrow variable names or narrative structure from an existing case.

relation_briefs.governed_premise: For this case's primary downstream model, the quantitative exposure must be the direct continuous prediction from the declared calibration model, retaining the continuous measurement scale.
relation_briefs.contrasting_construction: Use a classifier-derived hard category, rounded state, or posterior expected category count as the quantitative exposure in the primary downstream model.
relation_briefs.relation_that_must_be_clear_when_support: Which representation enters the selected primary downstream model: a direct continuous calibrated prediction or a value derived from discrete class states.
relation_briefs.generalization_guidance: The calibrated quantity may be copy dosage or another ordered abundance with discrete reference labels and a retained continuous signal.

relation_briefs.governed_premise: For this case's primary somatic target population, eligibility must be determined by the declared purity- and local-copy-adjusted clonal-fraction window.
relation_briefs.contrasting_construction: Use a raw variant-signal threshold together with a direct local copy-number ceiling as the primary eligibility gate, without applying the required adjusted clonal-fraction window.
relation_briefs.relation_that_must_be_clear_when_support: Whether target eligibility is governed by the adjusted clonal-fraction window or by direct raw-signal and local-copy thresholds.
relation_briefs.generalization_guidance: Choose a new somatic-analysis story and thresholds; the packet supplies the representation relation, not universal biological cutoffs.

relation_briefs.display_name: Joint local-target regression with guide nuisance terms
relation_briefs.governed_premise: For this case's primary local perturbation effect, all measured target axes must be fit jointly in one regression with the declared observed guide-level nuisance terms.
relation_briefs.contrasting_construction: Subtract an externally estimated contribution for one target before fitting, then regress the residualized outcome on only the remaining target axis without the required joint nuisance-adjusted specification.
relation_briefs.relation_that_must_be_clear_when_support: Whether measured target axes and guide nuisance terms are estimated together in the primary model or one contribution is removed before a reduced fit.
relation_briefs.generalization_guidance: Use a new perturbation, intervention, or multi-target assay story with genuine observed nuisance variables rather than reproducing an existing analysis.

relation_briefs.display_name: Full-map exposure in a transition-time estimate
relation_briefs.governed_premise: For this case's primary transition-time estimate, the exposure denominator must use the complete declared chromosome or sequence map, including map intervals without retained high-confidence state calls.
relation_briefs.contrasting_construction: Use only the summed length of retained or confidently called state tracts as the primary exposure denominator.
relation_briefs.relation_that_must_be_clear_when_support: Whether the primary denominator is the complete map exposure or only the retained called-tract exposure.
relation_briefs.generalization_guidance: The setting may use chromosome maps or another mapped sequence with gaps, provided the full-versus-retained exposure distinction remains scientifically coherent.

matrix_contract.construction_rule: For each block, create one newly authored case for every relation-by-cell combination. Retain every assigned outcome without replacement.
matrix_contract.evidence_status: This template and any unreviewed authored case are study materials only, not independent labels, qualification evidence, detector validation, promotion authority, or Findings.
